recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It completes FHIR-17273 in current active prose and operation/resource comments without changing the already-correct MeasureReport StructureDefinition cardinality or target type. No additional related issue commit is needed from this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-17273 was Published with a Persuasive CQI resolution for STU3. It requested changing MeasureReport.evaluatedResources from Reference(Bundle) to evaluatedResource 0..* Reference(Any), allowing a MeasureReport to directly reference each resource used in calculation and to travel with those resources in a Bundle when needed.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by e169985949ad77cfed6c6e86ee8036a90f98136e, the git-svn import of SVN 14046. That application renamed the element, changed its cardinality/type from 0..1 Reference(Bundle) to 0..* Reference(Any), and updated a CMS146 example from Bundle/456 to a direct Condition/123 reference.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active CQI resources in source/fhir.ini, and clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html is listed in the current source hierarchy. The authoritative current MeasureReport StructureDefinition already defines MeasureReport.evaluatedResource as 0..* Reference(Resource). Later related reconciliations for FHIR-17585 and FHIR-34033 are already present on the combined branch and support preserving direct, bounded evaluatedResource references.
reconciliation: This commit updates active stale source text that still used the obsolete plural element name or described an evaluatedResources bundle. The Quality Reporting page, the $data-requirements OperationDefinition footer/comment, and the Measure.group.population.criteria comment now refer to MeasureReport.evaluatedResource and direct resource references.
source_changes: source/clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html: changed Bundle organization, duplicate-data, and example prose from obsolete evaluatedResources wording to MeasureReport.evaluatedResource direct references.
source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-data-requirements.xml: changed both data-requirements footer/comment references from evaluatedResources to evaluatedResource.

source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml: changed the Measure.group.population.criteria comment from an evaluatedResources bundle to Observation resources referenced by MeasureReport.evaluatedResource.

related_jiras.note: Later STU3 clarification for data-requirements/evaluatedResource wording is already represented on the combined branch; this commit only aligns that active text with FHIR-17273's singular direct-reference element name.

Later Published CQI clarification refined evaluatedResource scope for individual and data-exchange reports and is already represented on the combined branch; it supports bounded direct-resource references rather than Bundle references.
